subject: Customer request: region-specific legal-hold + deletion amendment
messages:
From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@findata.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophia Grant <sophia.grant@findata.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: legal-hold + region-specific deletion window

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Two compliance items came up from our legal team that we need clarified before we can finalize procurement paperwork: 

1) Legal-hold override: For EU and US customer data, we need a way to place a customer-initiated legal hold that prevents automatic deletes for a given tenant (and export an audit log showing who placed the hold and when). The hold must be reversible only by an authorized FinData SID or a signed request.

2) Region-specific auto-delete windows: We need the ability to configure per-customer (per-tenant) auto-delete windows by region — e.g., 30 days for logs in US, 180 days for certain PII in EU — and an immutable audit trail when retention windows are shortened or extended.

Can Redwood support these with the hosted offering or would this require a Dedicated/Private deployment? Also: what are the expected timelines and any contract amendments required?

Attached is a short compliance checklist from our SOC team. Happy to hop on a call.

— Evan
Security & Compliance, FinData

Attachment: compliance-checklist-findata.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cho <evan.cho@findata.com>
Cc: Sophia Grant <sophia.grant@findata.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: legal-hold + region-specific deletion window

Evan — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the checklist. Short answer: we can support both items, but the implementation path and timelines differ depending on whether you require the controls at tenant-level in our Hosted plan or as part of Dedicated/Private. 

High-level: 
- Legal-hold override: We currently have a global admin legal-hold primitive in Dedicated/Private. For Hosted customers, we can implement a tenant-level legal-hold flag plus a signed-request flow (DocuSign-style) and an audit export, but it will require a prioritized engineering effort and a minor SLA/terms amendment.
- Region-specific auto-delete windows: We have per-region storage tiers and configurable TTLs at the tenant layer in Dedicated and Private today. For Hosted, we can add a per-tenant region retention matrix (config + immutable audit events) — engineering estimate ~6–8 weeks for an MVP + 3-week follow-up for audit/export polish.

I’m looping in Priyom (Product) and Mina (Engineering) to scope technical work & propose an owner/ETA. Laura — can you flag if this needs legal/contract language right away so we can draft an SLA amendment?

Next steps proposed: 
1) Internal scoping (P: Priyom) — define MVP surface (legal-hold API, tenant retention matrix UX, audit exports).
2) Engineering feasibility + rollout plan (E: Mina) — Hosted MVP vs Dedicated feature parity plan and security review.
3) Contract/terms check (E: Laura) — language for DocuSign workflow and SLA amendment triggers.

Evan — if that sounds OK I’ll get a one-page project plan to you by Thu.

Best,
Alex
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: scoping for FinData legal-hold + regional retention

Team — quick technical scoping notes after reviewing Evan's checklist and Alex's summary. I sketched an MVP that minimizes infra churn for Hosted customers: 

MVP scope (Hosted):
- Tenant-level retention matrix: UI + API where customer sets per-region retention buckets (e.g., retention_us_logs=30d, retention_eu_pii=180d). Stored as an immutable config revision per change.
- Legal-hold flag: tenant.legal_hold objects with metadata: placed_by (email), placed_at (ISO), reason, signed_request_id (optional). When legal_hold=true, automated deletions skip objects with tenant tag and we write a hold_event to audit log.
- Audit export: daily manifest export (CSV/NDJSON) with hold events and retention config changes. Exports stored in customer's residency region and available via presigned link for 30 days.

Engineering effort estimate: 6 weeks (2 engineers full-time) for API + datastore + config-rev + simple UI; +2 weeks for export and signed-request integration. Security review and threat modeling: 1 week.

Risks & decisions: 
- Signed-request enforcement: do we accept DocuSign webhooks to flip the flag or require Redwood to hold a signed PDF stub? Both are doable — DocuSign webhooks preferred for automation but legal may insist on stored signed artifact.
- Immutable audit: we need append-only logs for the audit trail — suggest using our existing write-once audit bucket with object versioning enabled. This will be a Hosted-feature toggle.

Owner assignments: 
- API + datastore: Mina Haddad (eng)
- UI + product flow: Priyom Das
- Contract language + approvals: Laura Bennett
- Customer comms + pilot: Alex Martinez

I’ll produce a one-page MRD and ticket set by EOD Thursday.

— Priyom
Senior Product Manager

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cho <evan.cho@findata.com>
Cc: Sophia Grant <sophia.grant@findata.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: legal-hold + region-specific deletion window — proposed plan and next steps

Evan — thanks for the patience. Quick summary and concrete next steps from our side: 

What we’ll deliver (Hosted MVP):
- Tenant-level retention matrix (per-region, per-data-class) with immutable config revisions.
- Legal-hold primitive at tenant scope that prevents auto-deletes and records placed_by/placed_at/reason.
- Audit export (daily manifest) with hold events and config changes; exports stored in the selected residency region and accessible via presigned links.
- DocuSign integration option: Redwood can accept DocuSign webhook-to-API to flip holds and will retain the signed artifact in the audit bucket.

Timeline:
- Internal kickoff: Mon 16 Feb
- Hosted MVP alpha: ~6 weeks from kickoff (end of Mar)
- Audit/export polish + DocuSign integration: additional 2–3 weeks (mid-Apr)

Contract/terms: Laura will draft a minimal SLA amendment and DocuSign acceptance clause. I’ve attached a draft SLA amendment and a starter retention matrix we’ll use for the pilot.

Attachments: SLA-amendment-draft.pdf, region-retention-matrix.xlsx

Next actions for FinData: please confirm whether you require: (A) DocuSign automation to place holds, (B) retention defaults for logs and PII per-region (we included a starter matrix), and (C) whether you want the audit export pushed to a FinData S3 (we can presign or push to a connector).

If you’re happy we can schedule a 30-minute kickoff this week.

Best,
Alex
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: SLA-amendment-draft.pdf (pdf), region-retention-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
